bullets.text: Ofcom Fines Virgin Media £23.8m - Ofcom penalises **Virgin Media** for endangering vulnerable customers during digital landline migration.

Monetizing 5G Standalone is Key - Carriers must focus on monetizing **5G SA** before considering **6G** advancements.

NTT's Growth Strategy Unveiled - **NTT** combines local expertise with global reach to drive data center innovation.
2026 Security Agenda Focus - Automated threats and cloud resilience are top priorities for enterprise security leaders.
Indian Government U-Turns on App - India reverses mandatory installation of a controversial mobile security app.
Sovereign AI Growth for Telcos - Major telcos positioned to benefit from government investments in sovereign AI infrastructure.
Telecom Consultants Essential - Property owners increasingly rely on telecom consultants to navigate complex connectivity decisions.
Closing the Deployment Divide - New solutions aim to bridge the gap between planned and actual tower deployments.
